question: Does the orientation-climate result remain at the same support class when public Taiwan occurrence coverage is expanded without lowering the frozen n>=10 gate or changing phylogenetic topologies?

frozen_primary.source_scope: source-name-guarded GBIF, Taiwan country scope, <=10 km primary coordinate uncertainty, 0.05 degree spatial thinning

refresh_design.gbif_refresh_result: Cirsium morii and Cirsium tatakaense remained at nine environment-complete thinned GBIF records each; the frozen primary therefore did not change from the GBIF refresh alone.

native_tbn_tier.definition: Direct TBN Plant records only: external_id starts tbn.dp.plant.; source is a direct plant.tbn.org.tw occurrence URL; CC BY; <=10 km uncertainty; new 0.05 degree cell relative to GBIF; one record per taxon-cell.

non_gbif_tbn_tier.definition: All source-name-guarded strict TBN records not explicitly marked as GBIF mirrors, <=10 km uncertainty, new 0.05 degree cells relative to GBIF, one record per taxon-cell.

decision.new_result: The orientation-climate effect direction is robust to accepted topology, species leave-one-out and occurrence-source expansion, but threshold-based support class is sensitive to the occurrence-source definition used to estimate present-day niche centroids.
decision.interpretation: The remaining uncertainty is not driven by sign instability across phylogenies or by a single taxon. A conservative direct-TBN expansion crosses the frozen threshold, whereas a broader non-GBIF TBN expansion does not. The current primary GBIF-only result should therefore remain unresolved until an occurrence-source harmonization rule is frozen independently of outcome.
decision.prohibited_promotion: Do not promote only the direct-TBN tier as the new primary because it is the tier that crosses P<0.05; do not treat the broader tier as evidence of no ecological relationship because the effect direction remains fully stable.

claim_boundary: Present-day niche centroid sensitivity only. This result does not reconstruct ancestral climate, identify a historical environmental cause, establish adaptation or convergence, or supersede the frozen GBIF-only primary without a predeclared occurrence-source harmonization contract.
